sampling: Per-label capped random sample, max 30000 per label; rare classes retained in full

model.anomaly: Median imputation + StandardScaler + IsolationForest(n_estimators=100), fit on benign training flows
model.anomaly_threshold: 98th percentile of benign validation anomaly scores

caveats: Pilot sample only; capped sampling changes natural class proportions.
Withheld CICIDS2017 attack class is a controlled unknown-class proxy, not proof of real-world zero-day detection.
No cross-dataset validation or LLM/RAG explanation evaluation has been completed.
